(ja)༄༅/ /gtor chen gyi lo rgyus dang cho ga bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di'i lo rgyus ni/ba ri lo tsā ba bal yul da

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// gtor chen gyi lo rgyus dang cho ga bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ ba ri lo tsā ba bal yul du byon nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta gcig spyan drangs nas byon pa dang*/ gser med nas pu rang du byon pa dang*/ btsad po rtse lde dang mjal nas rgyal po la dbang bskur byas chos bshad pas/ rgyal pos gser gung srang brgya tham pa phul skad/ de rnams paṇ+ḍi tas tshags byas nas/ bla ma bdag la'ang bag tsam zhig gnang ba zhu byas pas/ ma gnang bar slar rgol ba log par byed du byung skad/ shin tu sun nas paṇ+ḍi ta bal yul du skyel du byon skad/ de nas bal yul du sleb ka'i yul du mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta skal ldan rgyal po zhes bya ba gcig dang phrad nas/ kho na re/ khyod kyis nga'i lo tsā ba gyis la bod du 'gro dgos zer nas byung skad/ de la bla mas mi byed byas pas/ kho na re/ ngas mu stegs kyi chos mi bshad/ sangs rgyas pa'i chos bshad kyis zer yang*/ bla mas ma gsan pas/ kho na re/ khyod la mthu byed zer nas/ bla mas ngas khyod la nyes pa byas pa med/ mthu bya thabs med gsungs nas rgya gar du byon skad/ de nas bla ma rdo rje gdan pa dang mjal nas chos gsan cing yod pa dang*/ bla ma na re/ khyod la mu stegs kyi gnod pa yong bar 'dug gsungs pas/ mi yong ngam min lags zhus pas/ yong ba 'dug gsungs/ 'o na bal yul du mu stegs skal ldan rgyal po zhes bya ba de dang phrad nas 'di ltar byung lags zhus pas/ bha ya nā sa'i sngags dang gtor ma 'di gnang nas/ bha ya nā sa'i sngags bzlas/ gtor chen lan gsum btang ba'i tha ma la kho shi skad/ des na 'di byin rlabs che ba yin gsungs so// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro rnams srid mtsho las sgrol zhing*// blo chen dang ldan bla ma dang*// dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug la// btud de gtor ma'i cho ga bri// ngan rtogs smra ba'i dri bral zhing*// phan pa sbyin par byed pa yi// gang zag gnas dus yo byad dang*// cho ga phan yon drug sdom yin// de la gtor ma gtong ba'i slob dpon/
bum bzlas byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa gnyis ka dam tshig dang sdom pa ldan pa/ khro bo gang rung gi bsnyen pa sngon du song bas bya'o/

de yang rdo rje rigs kyi khro bo gang rung gis chog pa gsungs kyang de ngas phal cher rdo rje rnam 'joms la mdzad pas de'i rjes gnang sogs thob cing bsnyen pa song ba zhig gal che/ /gtor g.yogs pa gnyis kyang lha'i rnal 'byor dang srung ba dang ldan pa ste/ de ltar bzhi ka'ang gtor ma'i bya ba ma tshar bar du ngag bcad par bya'o// gnyis pa gnas ni mi dang dud 'gro la sogs pas dben pa dgos te/ gtor ma bshams pa'i sa phyogs de phyags dar la sogs pa gtsang mar bya zhing*/ ba'i rnam lngas byugs pa dang me tog la sogs pa dgram par bya'o// gsum pa dus ni gza' dang skar ma bzang po 'joms pa'i tshe bya/ bzhi pa yo byad ni/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor phyogs re la khru bzhi pa/ de ma shong na'ang khru gsum las chung ngu mi rung ngo*// der chos 'byung bsgrub bya'i sgo phyogs su rtse mo bstan pa de yang phyi re khā gru bzhi rim pa gnyis can/ de'i nang du'ang re khā gru gsum chos 'byung gi dbyibs can mdun dang g.yas g.yon gyi zur rnams gru bzhi phyi ma'i re khā la thug pa/ rtse mo dgra phyogs la bstan pa'am dmigs bsal med na gtor ma 'phen phyogs su bstan no// tshon rtsi dkar pos bri bar bya'o// de'i dbus su gtor ma snod chen po rdza'am zangs gang yang rung ba bzhag go sgyed bu chung ngu gsum gyi steng du theb kyu dang*/ chan cung zad blugs la bzhag lcags snod du mi bya/ /mchod pa ni me tog la sogs pa bdun rim bzhin bsham mo/ rang gi g.yon gtor ma'i g.yas ngos nas bzung*/ rang dang gtor ma'i bar du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ /gtor ma ni yul gang yin pa'i bres bcal ba'i khal gcig bre bzhi legs par bkrus la/ phyed chan du btso/ phyed zan du bya'o// de ma 'byor na bre bcu gnyis la snga ma bzhin du bya'o// zan la theb kyu mnyam po brgya rtsa brgyad/ chan la'ang de bzhin du snod mnyam po gcig gis bya'o/

brgya rtsa brgyad/ /gzhan yang dkar gsum mngar gsum sbyar ba'i ar+gha bre gsum mam bzhi bsham/ gzhi 'o mas bya/ bum pa zag rdol med pa bre gsum shong ba/ de ma rnyed na bre gang shong ba/ mgul chings bcing*/ bgegs bsal/ ar+gha dang dri chus dgang*/ g.yas kyi sgrub g.yog gi mdun tu bzhag bum bzlas pa'i mdun tu bzhag pa'am maṇ+ḍal gyi grar bum gdan gyi steng du bzhag mtha' skor du chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga bsham/ zlog glud ni rjen phye btsos la nad pa la sogs pa gang rung gi khru gang byas la/ lung thang gi mig dang*/ mgron bu'i so dang*/ zho sha'i snying*/ sbyin bdag gi gzugs can/ skye cha/ skra tshab nor bu'i rgyan dang*/ rab byung la skra tshab mi dgos/ zhwa la sogs pa gang yin ltar bya'o// de chos 'byung gi rtse mo'i phyogs su shing la sogs pa'i steng du/ des gtor snod kyi nang mthong tsam du bzhag go /gzhan dag byad byed pa yod na rang gi 'khor ci tsam yod pa dang*/ gang bsrung ba'i mi rnams la zan kham re gtad la de dag gi dri ma la dril bar bya'o// des ni dkyil 'khor dang mchod pa bsham pa dang*/ gtor ma'i yo byad bsham pa dang*/ bum pa dang zlog glud bsham pa lnga'i yo byad bstan pa'o// lnga pa cho ga ni/ sngon du pha rol tu phyin pa'am/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa la sogs pa'i mdo 'don pa dang*/ dkon mchog mchod pa la sogs pa dang*/ rang gi chos skyong ba rnams la gsol mchod rgyas pa byed pa la sogs pa sngon tu song bas/ nyi ma snur mnan song ba dang*/ gtor ma la 'jug par bya'o// de'ang sgrub pa po gang zag bzhi ka khrus legs par byas la/ slob dpon stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ gtor g.yog pa gnyis kyang g.yas g.yon du bde chas su 'dug la/ sngags g.yog g.yas su bum pa'i rtsar 'dug tu bzhugs/ bum 'dzin pa slob dpon gyi rtsar 'dug pa ni nor ba'o// gtor g.yog kyang gnyis nges par dgos/

gal te rnal 'byor can ma 'byor na 'khor lo sngags mdud sogs srung ba zab mo sbyin la sdod du gzhug go/ de nas rang gi mdun du bum pa chus bkang ba'i steng du mthu zlog sogs drag po ma yin na 'di mi dgos/ chu snyims pa gsum shong ba'i snod bzhag la/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed par bya ste/ bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ sems can thams cad srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral bar bya snyam du sems bskyed la/ lha gang rung de yang dpon slob bzhi kas mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ skyabs 'gro nas bzung te rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi bdag bskyed dang bzlas pa gang mang bya/ mjug gi ye shes pa gshegs gsol gzhan rnams kyis byed/ slob dpon gyis mi bya ba nam mkhar bzhugs par bsams te/ mchod yul gyi gtso bo dang dpang gzu'i dpang po yin gsung*/ gzhan rnams kyis bum pa tshul bzhin bsgrub/ du bskyed do// sngags g.yog kyang khro bo gang rung nga rgyal byas la/ bum pa la khro bo gang rung gi bzlas pa byed du gzhug go /de nas g.yas kyi gtor g.yog pas chan dang ar+gha blugs/ g.yon gyi gtor g.yog pa zan dang chu blugs/ de yang slob dpon gyi mdun du gtor theb gnyis bzhag pa'i gcig tu bshams pa de bsngo ba'i ring la gcig shos su bsham/ de nyid bsngo ba'i ring la snga ma der bsham pa de ltar re mos su bya'o// yang na g.yas kyi mis zan dang*/ chan blugs/ g.yon gyi mis ar+gha dang chu blugs kyang 'dra'o// de nas slob dpon gyis 'di la sbyin/ 'di la mi sbyin pa'i dmigs pa gang yang mi byed par lag pa g.yon pa snying gar khu tshur bcangs nas chos gos kyi nang du rdo rje dang bcas pas/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin gyi mthe bong dkyil du bcug dril bu dang bcas pas srin lag gi rtsa ba non pa/ pa'i chos 'byung gi phyag rgya dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor du ram̐ bsam/

dmar po me 'bar ba/ de'i steng du a bsam/ dkar po/ rim gyis a mes zhu bas bdud rtsir song*/ de gtor snod du song bas snod de yang na mash+tsaṇ+ḍas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod ces zur 'debs phyi ma 'ga' zhig las 'byung zhing*/ lag len la byed mod/ gu ru rin po che sogs kyis ma gsungs pas dmigs pa dkyus bzhin gyis chog par mngon no// yangs shing rgya che ba/ de bdud rtsis gang bar bsam zhing*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta/ a ba lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun bzlas la/ g.yas kyi phyag rgya kha sbub la/ mchod pa lnga ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar dharmā ra ṇi brjod cing dril bu dkrol/ 'og ma rnams la 'bru gsum lan gsum res byin rlob pa ma gtogs 'dra'o// la reg tsam re bya'o// de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan ni brjod pa med/ de nas g.yas kyi gtor g.yog pas snod chen por blugs la bshal lo/ bshal chu yang snod der blugs zhes gung rus gsungs/ de ltar lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'i bar du btang la/ glud de snod de'i nang du gzhug kha phyir bstan la bzhag cing chab bran/ slob dpon gyis thal mo sbyar nas dpang gzu rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa bzhin tshar gsum brjod/ dpang gzu tshar re'i mjug tu rol mo bya bar gsungs pas dril gsil re bya zhing*/ mtha'i tshig ris dang mthun pa'i dmigs pa bya/ yang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi btang la/ slar yang byin rlabs rgyas pa nas brtsam gong bzhin/ mthu bzlog pa dang 'dre gdon drag po bzlog par 'dod na/ gzugs de la dri ma mi btang*/ snying khar ming rus dang bcas pa'i liṅga gzhug

dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes liṅgar dgug gzhug bya/ liṅga la khrag bsku/ dgra bgegs bsad sems kyis gtor ma gtang*/ lnga bcu rtsa bzhi thongs pa dang*/ rten de gtor ma'i nang du spyi'i tshugs su bzhag go /de'i steng du yang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi po gtang ngo*// sngar gyi bum pa snod dang bcas pa'i chus/ gzugs de'i steng du yan lag lnga khrus byas la blug go /mar me lnga yang gzugs go /gzhan lhag ma rnams 'dra'o// yang 'di 'dra ba zhig gsungs te/ gdon zhi bar 'dod pa la gtor ma lnga bcu rtsa bzhi po thongs pa dang*/ gzugs de gtor ma'i nang du yug re bzhag yang gdon/ gtor ma rdzogs pa dang bzhag gsungs te mi gtso/ yab zan gyi liṅga brgya rtsa byas la/ gtor ma re dang spel gsungs te mi gtso/ de nas slob dpon gyis mnyes pa'i dpang po gzugs pa tsam byas te mchod pa dang*/ zan gyi lhag po byung na snod der blugs la/ bum chog pa rnams kyi bzlas pa bsdus nas mchod bstod sogs bya/ slob dpon gyis dpang gzu lan gsum dang*/ bdag gi bsam pa'i sogs dang bden stobs brjod/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur shog /ces bya ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ rje btsun bla ma rnams dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ dam tshig can rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bdag gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma kha dog phun sum tshogs pa/ dri phun sum tshogs pa/ reg bya phun sum tshogs pa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa 'dis/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i bar chad thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ rmi lam ngan pa dang*/

ltas ngan pa dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ nad dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ gdon dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin tu 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bden pa'i stobs brjod lan gsum brjod/ rgyas par spro na sa lo'i zur 'debs nas 'byung ba bzhin brjod na legs so// khyad par du klu'i gnod pa srung na/ klu sman sna tshogs dang*/ ba'i 'o ma gud du bshams pa la/ 'bras yos btab pa khyer/ mdun du dung la sogs pa'i sgra 'gro/ gtor ma khyer ba dang mnyam po g.yas kyi ngos nas/ bum bzlas pas khro bo gang rung gi sngags drag po zlos shing*/ bum pa'i chu sgreng zhing*/ khro bo'i 'gros kyis 'gro'o/ dmigs bsal rkang pas chos 'byung bri ba'i tshul gyis 'gro ba gung rus gsungs so/ /slob dpon gyis phyi nas rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu gsil la/ rkang pa khro bo'i 'gros kyis 'gro'o// sngags 'di bzlas/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas gnod pa'i bgegs gnas pa'i sa'am/ dgra'i yul mthong ba'i sar phyin nas bum chus chos 'byung bris la der gtor ma bzhag slob dpon gyis sngar bzhin dpang gzu dang*/ bden stobs brjod la/ gtor ma rab tu 'phang ngo*/ zhes gsungs kyang lag gnyis kyis bsgyel ba tsam byas pas chog cing*/ rkang pa g.yon pas snod kyi steng nas mnan la sum+bha sogs drag sngags brjod/ chos gos lan gsum brdab ces dang*/ gtor ma'i pra rtags ni/ mgo bo chad na gang la'ang ngan/ skra sen chad na byis pa la ngan/ gzhogs g.yas pa 'og tu shor na mo la ngan/ g.yon pa 'og tu shor na pho la ngan/ rkang pa g.yon rkyang na yul gyi g.yon phyogs la ngan/ rkang pa g.yas pa'ang des 'gre/ sbal pa kha sbub pa ltar song na shin tu legs pa yin no zhes gung ru rin po che gsungs/

pra rtags ngan na rgyab skyor rig pas dpyad la 'bad/ gzhan yang gtor ma'i gdong tshur lta ba dang*/ gtong ma rgyab mkhan 'gyel ba dang*// khal ma sogs tshur ded byung na ngan zhes dang*/ phyi rlung rgyab nas byung ba dang*/ nang rlung sna bug g.yon nas rgyu ba dang*/ khal ded sogs phar 'gro ba dang 'grig na shin tu legs pa yin no// zhes zur 'debs phyi ma 'ga' zhig las 'byung ngo*/ /lhag ma ma lus par bya'o/ bum chu lhag mas gtor snod bshal lo/ /gos thu brdab/ 'o dod 'bod/bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags drag tu bzlas/ mkhar gyi ngos la brgyab na nges par 'jig go /klu'i gnod pa bzlog pa ni/ chu bor bskyal/ de nas kun gyi phyi mig mi lta bar/ slob dpon gyis rting mnan te srung ba'i oṃ sarba duṣ+ṭan pra t+yaṃ ge ra phaṭ/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ sngags drag tu bzlas shing log la/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa nam mkhar bzhugs pa de la mchod bstod rgyas bsdus ci rigs dang 'dod don zhu ba dang yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs bzod gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ rang gi dpral ba oṃ sogs kyis bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo ba smon lam dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// bza' btung bzang pos tshims par bya/ slob dpon la sogs pa la'ang bsnyen bkur yang bya/ dpa' zas kyi tshul du thams cad mgu bar byas nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// drug pa phan yon ni/ nges par 'chi ba slu ba dang*// gzhan gyi rbod gtong phyir zlog pa dang*/ gdug pa klu'i nad sel bar byed nus pa dang*/ rims nad srung ba dang*/ dgra bo rlag par byed nus pa sogs phan yon dpag tu med pa yod kyang*/ 'dir gtso bo rang gi gnod pa srung zhing gzhan gyi gnod pa zlog pa'o// de ltar gtor ma'i cho ga gsal bar byas pa yis// dge ba 'di yis 'di byed pa yi skye bo rnams// gdug pa'i gnod pa las grol tshe ring nad med dang*// bde ba phun sum tshogs pa'i 'bras bu myur 'byin shog

/sa māp+ta/ gang zhig rin chen grags pas gsungs pa rang rang gi /ngan rtog mngon rlom dug chu'i dri ma'i tshogs chen gyis// rnam par sbags pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga phal cher ni// lus nyon mongs pa kho nar zad kyi 'bras mchog min// gang zhig brtser ldan gsung gi bdud rtsi dag /bdag la gang babs de las 'bras bu ni// mchog chen rnam par skye bar byed pas na// zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gdams ngag go /// theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa bsod nams rtse mos sbyar ba'o/ /de ltar kha 'bar ma'i gtor chen du grags pa zur 'debs lhan thabs rigs mang du bzhugs kyang*/ deng sang gi grong chog pa rnams kyis lag len rgyang nas mthong bas chog par bzung ste lung dang mdzub khrid don du gnyer ba mi 'dug mod/ 'di nyid gdams pa zab mo zur pa zhig yin gshis rtsa ba'i gzhung lo rgyus dang bcas pa slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i lung rgyun 'phel na legs pas/ 'di ltar gyis shig ces mnga' ri mang spro bla ma 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ paṇa chen gung ru shes rab bzang po'i lhan thabs gtsor bzung*/ sa lo dang*/ mkhan chen lhun grub dpal ldan sogs kyi zin bris dang*/ lag len dag nges sprin bar gyi nyi phur tsam mthong ba rnams la brten nas/ rgyal khams kyi mu to ba wā gin+d+ra su sid+dhis rtsa gzhung la mchan zhib tu btab nas bklag lung yang phyogs gcig tu byas pa sarba dik+ṣu war+gha du sh+ya tu//

༈ /sa lo chen pos mdzad pa'i gtor chen gyi zur 'debs bzhugs so// rdo rje khro bo rnams la 'dud// gtor ma chen po'i zur 'debs ni// gang zag gnas dus yo byad dang*// phan yon rnams ni rtse mo'i gzhung*// rtsa ba nyid las shes bya zhing*// cho ga'i gsal byed a wa brjod// rang gi mdun tu phyi lcags ri gru bzhi pa/ nang zur gsum rtse mo lho'am gnod pa ngos zin na dngos su bstan pa'i steng du dbus su gtor snod che ba lcags min pa'i mañdzi'am rdo'i stegs la bzhag slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi bar du g.yon nas rim par mchod pa bsham/ g.yas g.yon du chan dang ar+gha theb kyu blugs pa po'i mchod g.yog re/ slob dpon gyi g.yas dkyil 'khor la kha phyogs par bum chog mkhan 'dug ste bdag bskyed gnyis kas rnam 'joms bsgom/ gzungs ring ci rigs bzlas/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ de nas bum chog pas bum pa lhar bskyed bzlas pa byed cing*/ slob dpon gyis mdun gyi gtor ma chan sogs la dmigs nas lag g.yon rdo rje dang bcas snying gar khu tshur bcang*/ g.yas gtor mar bstan dril bu dang bcas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya la mthe bong dkyil du bkug nas srin lag gi rtsa ba non pa chos 'byung gi phyag rgya bya/ sems kyis lag mthil du ram̐ dmar po de'i steng du a dkar po/ ram̐ las me 'bar/ a zhu nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun gtor ma la babs par bsam/ saṃ bha ra'i sngags bdun re brjod/ lag g.yas phyag rgyas sngar gyi de kha sbub la mchod pa rnams la rim pa bzhin reg cing so so'i sngags brjod/ dharmā ra ṇi bya/ de ltar dkyus bzhin brgya rtsa brgyad song rjes mchod pa rnams dang chan zan ar+gha'i lhag ma thams cad zlog glud kyi mgor blug kha cig gtor ma cha gsum btang na'ang slob dpon rtse mos ma bshad cing phyag len la mi dgos/ slob dpon gyis thal mo sbyar nas dpang gzu brjod pa ni 'di skad do// bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/

bdag gis gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bgyis pa'i mthus yon bdag gam bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi nad dang gdon dang*/ bgegs dang*/ phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa dang*/ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ gzhan gyi rig sngags dang*/ rbod gtong dang*/ byad kha dang*/ 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa'i gnod pa thams cad phyir bzlog tu gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ bstan pa dang sems can mang po la 'tshe bar byed cing*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten dang gtsug lag khang la gnod par byed pa'i dgra dang*/ bgegs thams cad zhi ba dang bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ gang dag zhi bas mi thul ba gdug pa can mchis na de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams rdo rje khro bo'i tshogs su sprul nas bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs du ma dang bcas pas drag po'i las kyis gdug pa can de tshar gcod du gsol/ bdag gis nyes pa'i tshogs ci yang ma bgyis shing gdug pa can 'dis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa grangs med pa byas pas gdug pa can tshar gcod par rigs so// de rjes/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces bya ba dang*/ lhug pa'i bden stobs ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang dam tshig rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bdag gi bsam pa rnam par dag pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa/

reg bya phun sum tshogs pa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i char dag pa 'dis bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba'i bar chad thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ ltas ngan pa dang*/ nad dang gdon thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ bsam pa thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ ces bden pa'i stobs lan gsum brjod la/ bum chus sna drangs dung dang rol mo dang bcas brdeg sar slebs pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun gyi bka'= bya ba dang spyod pa dang rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor bla na med pa thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi'i yi dam zhi ba dang khro bo'i tshogs ji snyed thams cad kyi bka'= don dam chos nyid rnam par dag cing 'gyur pa med pa'i bden pa dang*/ kun rdzob chos can las 'bras bslu ba med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa dang*/ dpal mgon chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan zhing*/ las byed 'jig rten pa'i pho nya drag po'i mthu rtsal nus pa can rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ spyir dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las la bar du gcod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dam pa'i chos la smad pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde dkrugs pa/ sems can yongs la gnod 'tshe byed pa/ khyad par du dgon gnas 'di nyid la gnod par byed pa thams cad dang*/ sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad nyon cig mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di dang*/ zlog glud phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched dang*/ dbang po drug dang*/

yan lag nying lag don snying thams cad tshang zhing*/ gos rgyan sna tshogs dang bcas pa'i 'di khyer la gnod cing gdug pa'i bsam sbyor nye bar zhi nas rang bzhin gyi gnas su 'gro bar gyis shig gang dag bsam sbyor ngan pa de dag mi gtang na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba mgo bor snun cing bskal pa'i mes tshig par gyur cig bdag dang sbyin bdag rnams kyi lus la gnod pa'i bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi gdon stong phrag brgyad cu nad yams dang dal kha thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa 'khon grib ltas ngan byur dang skal pa ngan pa thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig pha rol gyi mthu dang byad kha phur kha mnan gtad 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa'i rbod gtong thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig des bzlas pa'i sngags dang byad kha rbod 'dre thams cad de nyid rang la bzlog par gyur cig rmi lam ngan pa mtshan ma ngan pa lo zla zhag dang za ma'i keg ngan/ chag che zhing nyam nga ba bkra mi shis pa thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig gzhan yang sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs/ gza' dang rgyu skar/ dmu dang bdud/ btsan dang gshin rje/ klu gnyan sa bdag rgyal 'gong the'u rang*/ dam sri bse mo'i rigs kyi gnod byed thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig mdor na bdag dang yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi nyon mongs bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig dkon mchog bslu ba med pa dang*// chos nyid bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// dgra bgegs gnod pa bzlog pa dang*// srung skyob mthu dang ldan gyur cig /gdug pa can thams cad phyir la zlog oṃ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ pra t+yaṃ gir phaṭa/

khos/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ srung srung bar mdzod/ de nas slob dpon gyis rjes mnan la nang du 'ongs te gong du bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun du phyung na/ de la mchod bstod bsdus pa byed/ ma byung bar rnal 'byor chen po'i lugs ltar byed na rang nyid la mchod bstod byas la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa brjod cing*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ ye shes pa phyung na/ badz+ra muḥ nam mkha'i ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje khro bo 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yis sa la 'god par shog /ston mchog dam pa sogs kyi bkra shis bya'o// 'di ni byed mkhan mang na yang*// lag len nor ba mang mthong nas// brtse ba'i bsam pas kun bslangs te// don gnyer 'ga' yis bskul ba'i ngor// dpal ldan sa skya'i lo tsā ba// ā nan+da yis myur bar sbyar// dge bas mi shes mun bcom ste// kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal por shog /shu bhaṃ/ maṅga laṃ/ bden bdar bsdus pa ni/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pas gnod cing nye bar 'tshe ba dang*/ gang gis bdag la byad kha dang*/ gtad kha la sogs pa'i rbod gtong gi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad gtor ma chen po 'di 'phangs pas skad cig la de dag thams cad brlag par gyur cig

nye bar zhi bar gyur cig med cing mi 'byung bar gyur cig phyir bzlog par gyur cig bzlas pa'i sngags de nyid kyis rbod byed pa rang la brlag par gyur cig des rbad pa'i lha 'dre de dag kyang rbad byed rang la bzlog par gyur cig gzhan yang bdag gam sbyin bdag rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ dri za dang*/ lha ma yin la sogs pa'i dgra bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad kyang gtor ma chen po 'di 'phangs pas/ skad cig la brlag par gyur cig nye bar zhi bar gyur cig med cing mi 'byung bar gyur cig phyir bzlog par gyur cig dkon mchog bslu ba med pa dang*// chos nyid bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// dgra bgegs gnod pa bzlog pa dang*// srung skyobs mthu dang ldan gyur cig /sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ pra t+yaṅgi ra phaṭa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru ku ru swā hā/ de nas slob dpon gyis rjes mnan la nang du 'ong ba sogs bya'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
